name: OCSP Stapling
description: Enable OCSP stapling for SSL/TLS certificates. Improves certificate validation performance and privacy by reducing OCSP responder load.

OCSP_STAPLE_MODE.help: OCSP stapling mode: open (optional, no validation), staple_only (must have staple), normal (validated if available)
OCSP_STAPLE_MODE.label: OCSP staple mode

OCSP_ASYNC_VALIDATION.help: Enable asynchronous OCSP validation in background scheduler job (reduces TLS critical path latency)
OCSP_ASYNC_VALIDATION.label: Enable async OCSP validation

OCSP_ASYNC_SCHEDULE.help: How often the async validation job runs: minute (1 min), 5minute, hour
OCSP_ASYNC_SCHEDULE.label: Async validation schedule

OCSP_CACHE_DIR.help: Directory for OCSP response cache storage
OCSP_CACHE_DIR.label: OCSP cache directory

OCSP_QUEUE_TTL_PENDING.help: Redis TTL (seconds) for pending validation entries (86400s = 1 day). Aligned with 7-day certificate validity.
OCSP_QUEUE_TTL_PENDING.label: Pending queue TTL

OCSP_QUEUE_TTL_VALIDATED.help: Redis TTL (seconds) for validated response entries (604800s = 7 days). Matches 7-day certificate lifetime.
OCSP_QUEUE_TTL_VALIDATED.label: Validated responses TTL

OCSP_QUEUE_TTL_FAILED.help: Redis TTL (seconds) for failed validation entries (86400s = 24 hours). Failed entries are retried after 1 day.
OCSP_QUEUE_TTL_FAILED.label: Failed entries TTL

OCSP_QUEUE_TTL_PROCESSING.help: Redis TTL (seconds) for processing entries (3600s = 1 hour). Stale processing entries are automatically cleaned up and requeued.
OCSP_QUEUE_TTL_PROCESSING.label: Processing entries TTL

OCSP_RESPONDER_RETRY_INITIAL.help: Initial retry interval (seconds) when OCSP responder fails (300s = 5 minutes). Uses exponential backoff: 5min → 10min → 20min → ...
OCSP_RESPONDER_RETRY_INITIAL.label: Responder retry interval

OCSP_RESPONDER_RETRY_MAX.help: Maximum retry interval (seconds) for OCSP responder failures (86400s = 24 hours). Prevents infinite exponential backoff.
OCSP_RESPONDER_RETRY_MAX.label: Responder retry max interval

OCSP_BATCH_SIZE.help: Number of OCSP validations to process per job cycle (default: 10). Prevents startup DDOS when 1000s of certs need validation. Lower = slower warmup but less load on responder.
OCSP_BATCH_SIZE.label: Validation batch size

OCSP_REQUEST_RATE_LIMIT.help: Maximum requests per second to OCSP responder (default: 50 req/s). Prevents overwhelming the responder on startup. Tune based on responder capacity.
OCSP_REQUEST_RATE_LIMIT.label: OCSP request rate limit

OCSP_RATE_LIMIT_JITTER.help: Jitter percentage (0-100) to randomize request delays and prevent thundering herd (default: 20%). Adds ±20% randomization to spread out requests.
OCSP_RATE_LIMIT_JITTER.label: Rate limit jitter
